info.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Common Features (26C) - REST API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection (v2.1.0) containing all 485 REST API endpoints across 132 resource categories from the Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications Common Features (Release 26C) documentation.

**Source Documentation:** [All REST Endpoints - Oracle Applications Common 26C](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/applications-common/26c/farca/rest-endpoints.html)

### Configuration Variables
- `baseUrl`: Your Oracle Fusion Cloud host URL (e.g., `https://servername.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com`)
- `username` / `password`: Credentials for HTTP Basic Authentication
- `bearerToken`: OAuth 2.0 / JWT Bearer token (if using Bearer authentication)
- `restFrameworkVersion`: Oracle ADF REST Framework version header (default: `4`)

variable.description: Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications base server URL (without trailing slash)
Oracle Fusion Cloud username for Basic Auth
Oracle Fusion Cloud password for Basic Auth
OAuth 2.0 / JWT Bearer token if switching collection auth to Bearer

item.name: Bulk

request.description:
**Category:** Bulk
**Operation:** Bulk operation
**Method:** `POST`
**Documented Path:** `/hcmRestApi/scim/Bulk`
**Normalized Path:** `/hcmRestApi/scim/Bulk`

**Resource Description:**
The bulk operation is used to send a large collection of resource operations in a single request. The body of a bulk operation contains a set of HTTP resource operations using any of the supported HTTP methods for Users and Roles resources. The supported HTTP methods for the bulk operation include POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE. Each bulk job can have multiple operations per resource. It may be beneficial to perform the bulk job in batches, for example 50 operations per batch.

**Reference:** [Oracle Fusion Cloud Common Features 26C REST Endpoints](https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/saas/applications-common/26c/farca/rest-endpoints.html)
